native.guide: How to use the firmware panel
native.instructions:
ALGORITHM selects the track; PRESETS selects its sound; SELECT sets tempo. Drag knobs up/down. Hold Shift for fine tuning. Focus a knob to use arrows or wheel; Shift prevents acceleration.
Tap a function button for its pages. Hold FX, EDIT, ARP, SEQ, SCL, GLO or SAVE while playing a key or turning a knob. Hold a layer button and tap HOME to lock it; HOME or another layer releases the lock.
FX: punch-in effects. EDIT: erase; OCT−/OCT+ undo/redo. ARP: rolls. SEQ: white keys toggle steps; hold a step and turn knobs to edit its note, level and ratchet. SCL: key and chords. GLO: mute, solo and track levels.
REC arms recording; the screen knobs choose free/tempo, length and note/count-in start. Play notes to record; REC closes a free take; PLAY cancels it. Hold REC to clear the selected track; EDIT + OCT− restores it.
SAVE opens the song arranger. Hold SAVE: white keys 1–4 recall sections A–D, 5–8 store them (repeat to overwrite), 13 toggles song playback, 14 arms song recording, 16 opens the song page.
Hold HOME for settings. In menus PRESETS moves, KNOB 1 changes values, OCT+ confirms and OCT− returns. Browser sessions autosave projects, presets, song order and settings. USB audio input and hardware calibration require a physical FM-1.
